dataList.content:
<I guess Ahab's not here yet...>
<亚哈好像还没有到的样子……>

Tsk... is that an Abnormality?
啧……是异想体吗？

Something twitched before us. An entity skewered by numerous fluorescent bars.
正如以实玛利所言，面前身体各处刺入了荧光色棒状物的某物，正在蠢蠢欲动。

… Get out of my way.
……滚开。

Perhaps it felt threatened when Ishmael grabbed her harpoon. It leaped out of the Lake and began rushing toward us.
或许是被以实玛利再次握紧捕鲸枪的姿态所刺激了，那东西像要飞出湖面一般，袭向了我们。
